name: Mip-NeRF RGB-D
definition: A neural scene representation method that uses RGB-D frames to represent 3D scenes using neural radiance fields. It incorporates depth information for local sampling and geometric loss to improve photometry and geometry accuracy while reducing training time.
summary: Mip-NeRF RGB-D reconstructs 3D scenes from multi-view RGB-D data by combining conical frustum sampling with explicit depth supervision to improve geometric accuracy and reduce training time.
